pos.personaBrief: Sassuolo had the highest possession share in Serie A 2020/21 and Brighton passed 70% repeatedly; he baits the press to attack space, but possession is the base and he says control depends on the opponent's pressure.

pro.personaBrief: Goalkeeper as third centre-back, 94% short goal kicks and deliberate inviting of the press show patient build-up, though quick vertical attacks follow once the press is broken or after counter-press regains.

est.personaBrief: 2-3-5 and 3-2-5 with defined phases, maximal width and free players between the lines point to a positional structure with rotations; the striker dropping and wrong-footed wingers add some relational touches.

lar.personaBrief: Both touchlines are always occupied (McCormack, Analytics FC maximal width) and Ligue 1 notes more direct play down the flanks, while the centre is conservative; width is structural.

blo.personaBrief: Sassuolo pressed very aggressively, Brighton used an aggressively high line, counter-press everywhere and a lock-the-ball-to-one-side press; he even invites the press, but never sits deep.

mar.personaBrief: Man-oriented first wave of pressing at Sassuolo, man-marking in the area and man-to-man pressing per the Premier League; no source on corners, and set pieces are an admitted disinterest.

pla.personaBrief: He wants to win with his own style and imposes the same model in every club; he does adjust shape (3-5-2 vs tougher opponents) but principles stay.

res.personaBrief: Courage and style come first (win with my style, Brighton kill games with the ball), refusing to defend leads; yet he also states he must win, so both matter, with the how emphasised.

sis.personaBrief: A strong method and role-defined build-up that improves players, and he demands tracking back from stars like Greenwood; no star license.

jog.personaBrief: Requires extremely athletic players in key positions and pressing intensity, but build-up demands technical defenders and midfielders who pass.

bas.personaBrief: Known for developing youngsters at Sassuolo and Brighton, but builds through signings, wants to keep experienced players and complained about thin transfer activity.

lid.personaBrief: Relationship-focused (dinners, trust in key players, personal talks) but demanding of all, including stars; spirit and behaviour come before style.
